name: Absolute Electronics
old_description: Absolute PCB Assembly specializes in custom PCB Assembly services, tailoring our processes to meet the unique specifications and demands of each client. Our commitment to excellence ensures the delivery of high-quality electronic devices.
about:
Absolute Electronics Services, based in Addison, Illinois, has provided PCB assembly solutions since 1995. The company operates as a contract manufacturer serving a range of electronics sectors from its single Midwest location.

Its core offering centers on printed circuit board assembly using automated surface-mount and through-hole lines, with capabilities that include BGA placement, flexible circuit assembly, conformal coating, and rework and repair. Beyond bare-board assembly, the shop provides wire and cable harness fabrication, box-build integration, mechanical and electromechanical assembly, and full turnkey procurement alongside kitted or consigned material models. Inspection relies on automated optical inspection (AOI), 3D X-ray, in-circuit test, and functional test.

The customer base spans industrial equipment, LED lighting, RF/IoT/M2M, automotive, medical, telecommunications, and consumer electronics. Testimonials reference an industrial electronics manufacturer (Tescor Products LLC), a telecom manufacturer, and a consumer electronics manufacturer.

The company highlights its ITAR-registered, U.S.-based facility as a supply-chain security advantage, promising turnkey execution under one roof and lead times as short as 48 hours. Its stated differentiators also include military-grade inspection technology and domestic customer support from Addison.
